summary: OpenAI has launched the Australian Youth Safety Blueprint, a significant initiative designed to enhance online safety for youth by establishing a comprehensive six-pillar framework. Meanwhile, Google DeepMind's introduction of Gemini 3.8 Live and 3.8 Live Extended Thinking marks a notable advancement in AI capabilities, potentially transforming how AI systems operate. In the investment landscape, AI startup TrustedRouter has raised $1.25 million, reflecting growing interest in AI technology. Additionally, Google AI is expanding its team with new experts to bolster research at the intersection of AI and economics, while Microsoft Research has developed GigaPath-Flash and GigaTIME-Flash models to improve pathology studies by reducing computational demands, thereby facilitating larger-scale research.

items.original: New experts join Google’s AI & Economy team. We are expanding our AI & Economy team with world-class academic advisors, fellows, and core internal researchers.

This expansion aims to strengthen the team's capabilities in exploring the intersection of artificial intelligence and economic research. The addition of these professionals will help drive innovative projects and insights in the field.

items.original: Show HN: Diffusion PDF – A Diffusion Image Model Embedded Entirely in a PDF File
items.rewritten: This project presents Diffusion PDF, which is a diffusion image model that is fully integrated within a PDF file. It allows for the generation and manipulation of images using diffusion techniques, all contained in a single, portable document format. This innovation makes it easier to share and utilize advanced image modeling without needing separate software.

items.original: GigaPath-Flash and GigaTIME-Flash: Toward population-scale discovery with efficient pathology foundation models. What if pathology foundation models could do more with less? GigaPath-Flash and GigaTIME-Flash cut computational demands while maintaining strong performance, opening the door to larger studies and broader exploration. The post GigaPath-Flash and GigaTIME-Flash: Toward population-scale discovery with efficient pathology foundation models appeared first on Microsoft Research .
items.rewritten: GigaPath-Flash and GigaTIME-Flash are new models designed to enhance pathology research by reducing computational requirements while still delivering high performance. These models aim to facilitate large-scale studies and broader investigations in pathology by making it easier to analyze data efficiently. This advancement could significantly impact how pathology research is conducted.
